critical_path.title: Verify successful page load and heading text
critical_path.description: This test case verifies that the main page loads successfully and the main heading text is displayed correctly.

steps.expected: The page loads successfully within a reasonable timeframe (e.g., 5 seconds).

assertions: The heading text matches the expected value.

critical_path.title: Verify 'More Information' link redirects to IANA website
critical_path.description: This test case verifies that the 'More Information' link redirects the user to the correct IANA website.

steps.expected: The browser navigates to the IANA website (specifically, 'https://www.iana.org/domains/example').

steps.action: Verify the URL of the new page.
steps.expected: The URL of the new page is 'https://www.iana.org/domains/example'.

assertions: The 'More Information' link is present on the page.
Clicking the link redirects to the expected IANA URL.

validation.title: Verify 'More Information' Link Redirection
validation.description: This test verifies that the 'More Information' link redirects to the correct IANA page and that the page loads successfully.

steps.expected: The browser should navigate to the IANA website (e.g., a specific IANA registry page).

steps.action: Verify that the IANA page loads successfully.
steps.expected: The IANA page should load without errors (e.g., 200 OK HTTP status code).

steps.action: Check the IANA page title or a specific element's text on the IANA page.
steps.expected: The IANA page title or the specified element's text should match the expected value.

assertions: The 'More Information' link redirects to the correct IANA page.
The IANA page title or a specific element's text matches the expected value.

validation.title: Verify Page Load and Heading Text
validation.description: This test checks if the page loads correctly and that the main heading text is accurate.

steps.expected: The page should load successfully without any HTTP errors.

steps.action: Inspect the main heading element (e.g., H1 tag).
steps.expected: The main heading element should be present and visible.

steps.action: Retrieve the text content of the main heading element.
steps.expected: The heading text should match the expected heading text.

assertions: The main heading element is present and visible.
The heading text matches the expected heading text.

error_handling.title: Verify 'More Information' Link Redirection with IANA Unavailability
error_handling.description: Tests the 'More Information' link behavior when the IANA website (third-party dependency) is unavailable or returns an error. This tests the application's error handling for external dependencies.

steps.action: Simulate IANA website unavailability (e.g., using a proxy to block access or mock a 500 error response).
steps.expected: The page should not crash or hang indefinitely.

The application should display a user-friendly error message (e.g., 'Unable to retrieve information from IANA at this time. Please try again later.') or gracefully degrade (e.g., link remains but does not redirect).

assertions: An appropriate error message is displayed to the user.
The page remains functional and does not crash or become unresponsive.
No sensitive error details (e.g., stack traces) are exposed to the user.

error_handling.title: Test Incorrect Heading Text Handling
error_handling.description: Tests how the application handles receiving unexpected data for the main heading. This simulates a system error where the heading is not set correctly.

steps.action: Modify the application or test environment to return an unexpected or empty string for the main heading (e.g., simulate a database error or API response issue).
steps.expected: The page should load without crashing.
The page displays a default or error heading (e.g., 'Error: Unable to load heading', or a placeholder text). The application does not crash or throw unhandled exceptions.

assertions: The page loads successfully, even with invalid heading data.
A default or error message is displayed in place of the expected heading.
No JavaScript errors or unhandled exceptions are thrown due to the missing or invalid heading.
The rest of the page content is rendered correctly.
